name: 進行中の奉仕タイマー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse catalog state variant LH11-0012 進行中の奉仕タイマー. Image1 ORIGINAL Jobber source has priority for proportions, alignment, spacing, fine controls and active-state anatomy; Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized copy guide. Image3 approved bus is white card/elevation styling only. The target is ONLY the lower running-time card, not the whole timeline, phone/calendar or top Clock Out strip.
Compact logical390x86 horizontal white rounded card on pure white #FFFFFF canvas, fine neutral outline and soft slight downward elevation. Header row left: modest bold Meiryo14/24 label 「奉仕時間」 followed by the exact value 「00:15」. The running VALUE00:15 must be FOREST GREEN #1F6444, matching original active green duration; label remains #1D1D1D. Mock incorrectly loses this active-state color; original controls this decision. Header right: small forest-green regular12/16 text action 「タイマーを止める」. Second row: regular14/24 「一般奉仕」. Keep exact saved Japanese wording and00:15; do not substitute source00:00 or simulate changing time. Tracking0, readable stable wrapping, no oversized title or all-bold body.
Original has no icons in this crop; do not add clock/stop symbol, avatars, progress rings, controls, metrics or a timeline rail. Retain source text-link Stop Timer anatomy, do not turn it into a big filled button. Purposeful accent: forest green on active timer value and stop action only, coherent with original running state. All ordinary surfaces white, neutral border, supporting text quiet. No broad mint, extra colored icon chips, glow, neon or gloss. Preserve the catalog state-variant identity; this raster does not prove real timer behavior, native editability or application implementation.
reviewNotes: 中断呼出しに出力/登録なしを照合後、保存済み同一プロンプトで再生成。原画優先の稼働状態として00:15と停止リンクを森林緑へ復元。奉仕時間/一般奉仕/停止文言、白面と整列、切れ/余分な操作なしを実見。独立部品数に含めない状態バリアント。正確な書体同定/実タイマー動作/所有者承認は未検証。画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
